subject: general
question: Which of the following politicians has never been a leader of the House in the Lok Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Manmohan Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Shri Manmohan Singh has never been a leader of the House in the Lok Sabha as he has never been a member of the Lok Sabha. He was a member of the Rajya Sabha.
 
• Shri Atal Bihari Bajpayee was the leader of the House in the Lok Sabha during his tenure as Prime Minister of India.
 
• Shri Pranab Mukherjee served as the leader of the House in the Lok Sabha when he was the Union Minister for Finance.
 
• Shri Narendra Modi is the current leader of the House in the Lok Sabha as he is the Prime Minister of India and a member of the Lok Sabha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Leader of the House in the Lok Sabha:**

 
 
• The Leader of the House is a parliamentary position held by the Prime Minister or a senior cabinet minister who is a member of the Lok Sabha.
 
• The Leader of the House is responsible for organizing government business and ensuring the smooth passage of legislation.
 
• The position is crucial in maintaining the government's control over the parliamentary agenda.
 
 
 
• **Lok Sabha:**
 
 
• The Lok Sabha is the lower house of India's bicameral Parliament, with members directly elected by the people of India.
 
• It is responsible for making laws, and the government is accountable to it.
 
• The maximum strength of the Lok Sabha is 552 members.
 
 
 
• **Rajya Sabha:**
 
 
• The Rajya Sabha is the upper house of India's Parliament, with members elected by the legislative assemblies of states and union territories.
 
• It represents the interests of the states and has a maximum strength of 250 members.
 
• The Rajya Sabha is a permanent body and is not subject to dissolution, but one-third of its members retire every two years.
